zh: 聊天右上角新增紧急求助。在本地协助可查看离线电话、选择国籍看使馆，也可把求助内容保存在本机。
打车支持滴滴估价和跳转。从行程地点点「打车去这里」可预填终点。
en: Open Emergency Help from the top right of Chat. Local Support includes offline phone numbers, an embassy for your selected nationality, and help drafts saved on this device.
Taxi shows DiDi estimates and opens DiDi. Tap Taxi here on a trip stop to fill in the destination.

zh: 与构建 51 相比，新增本地协助和打车。翻译使用千问处理文字、录音和照片。
en: Compared with build 51, this build adds Local Support and Taxi. Qwen translates text, recordings, and photos.

zh: 记录机型、iOS、语言和测试账号标签。首次安装后登录并同意，中英各问三题（含首都机场进城），生成并保存三天行程。强退重开、后台 10 秒和锁屏 60 秒后核对对话及草稿。
翻译文字和语音中英各三次（含一次无声录音），再测菜单、路牌、小票、药品说明各一张照片。用「完成」、点空白和上滑收起键盘。
从 SOS 进入协助，选择国籍，重开检查草稿，开启飞行模式再打开。拨号只用指定测试号码，到系统确认后取消。
打车从行程预填、估价、查看司机卡片，并核对已装和未装滴滴的表现。检查 Tab 顺序、中英、浅深色和字号。失败请截图并复制问题记录到 #1334。
en: Record the iPhone model, iOS version, language, and test account label. Sign in on a fresh install, accept the notice, ask three questions in each language including how to reach central Beijing from Capital Airport, and save a three-day trip. Check chat and drafts after a force-quit, 10 seconds in the background, and 60 seconds locked.

Translate three texts and three recordings in each direction, including a silent recording. Try a menu, sign, receipt, and medicine label. Dismiss the keyboard with Done, a background tap, and a swipe.
Open Emergency Help, choose your nationality, check the draft after reopening, and reopen in Airplane Mode. Use only the designated test number and cancel at the system prompt.

Try Taxi from a trip stop, check the estimate and driver card, and compare phones with and without DiDi. Check tabs, both languages, light and dark mode, and text size. Report failures with a screenshot and copied problem record in #1334.

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

zh: 酒店暂未开放。打车在滴滴确认页停止，不下单。翻译和估价需要联网。
en: Hotels are unavailable. Stop at DiDi’s confirmation screen without placing a ride. Translation and fare estimates require internet access.

zh: 获准的 G2C 测试账号可使用千问翻译和滴滴估价。
en: Eligible G2C test accounts can use Qwen translation and DiDi fare estimates.

zh: 翻译页改成上下双卡。上面输入文字、录音或选图，下面查看译文。底部可切换文字、语音和拍照，最近翻译从右上角打开。
en: Translation now has an input card above the result card. Add text, a recording, or a photo at the top and see the translation below. Switch modes at the bottom and open recent translations from the top right.

zh: 与构建 50 相比，切换输入方式会保留文字草稿，打开最近翻译会保留当前结果。照片译文仍逐行对照。
en: Compared with build 50, switching input modes keeps your text draft. Opening recent translations keeps the current result. Photo translations remain paired line by line.

zh: 核对上下双卡、互换语言、切换输入方式和打开最近翻译。用「完成」、点空白和上滑收起键盘，确认草稿仍在。核对聊天、行程、插件、记忆的顺序。
账号开通后，文字中英各三条，语音中英各三次（含无声录音），再测菜单、路牌、小票、药品说明各三张照片。
抽测构建 49 的第 1、3、4 项。强退重开恢复旧对话和草稿，历史打开旧和新对话，切后台 10 秒及锁屏 60 秒后恢复。
en: Check the two cards, language swap, mode switching and recent translations. Use Done, tap an empty spot and swipe up to dismiss the keyboard. Verify that the text draft stays and the tabs appear in Chat, Trips, Tools, Memory order.
Once your account is enabled, translate three texts and three recordings in each direction, including a silent recording. Test three photos each of menus, signs, receipts, and medicine instructions.
Repeat build 49 checks 1, 3, and 4. Restore an older chat and draft after a force-quit, open both chats from history, then return after 10 seconds in the background and 60 seconds locked.

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

zh: 翻译需要联网。真实千问翻译等账号开通后再测。
en: Translation requires an internet connection. Wait until your account is enabled before checking live translation.

zh: 本版调整翻译页面。账号资格与真实翻译复测通知见 #1274。
en: This build updates the Translation screen. See #1274 for account enablement and the live translation retest.
